findings.description: k is read from input but never validated. Using v[i] % k and v[i] / k when k == 0 crashes or is undefined.
abs(v[i] - h) is computed in int. For int, v[i] - h can overflow, and abs(INT_MIN) is undefined.
vector<int> v(n) is constructed from untrusted n without validation. Negative n can convert to a huge size_t and attempt massive allocation (DoS).
The macros read(...) declare a variable and attempt extraction; on failure the variable remains indeterminate.
